q: A displacement-distance graph describes the displacement of all particles at a particular instant of _____.
e: A displacement-distance graph describes the displacement of all particles at a particular instant of time.

q: In a displacement-distance graph, the displacement of the particle is plotted on the _____.
e: Note that displacement of particle is plotted on y-axis and distance moved by the wave is on x-axis.

q: A displacement-time graph describes the displacement of a particle of a certain position as a function of _____ taken to travel by a wave.
e: A displacement-time graph describes the displacement of particle of a certain position as a function of time taken to travel by a wave.

q: In a displacement-time graph, the time interval is plotted on the _____.
e: Note that displacement of particle is on Y axis and time interval is on X axis.
